definitions.explanation: A person who possesses substantial assets such as property, investments, or savings. Focuses on accumulated wealth and assets rather than high income.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{資産家|しさんか}だ。
examples.english: He is a well-known wealthy person in the local area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{財|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}した{資産家|しさんか}だった。
examples.english: My grandfather was a wealthy man who made his fortune in real estate.

examples.japanese: {資産家|しさんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}している→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Many wealthy individuals establish corporations as a tax strategy.

notes:
USAGE:
{資産家|しさんか} emphasizes accumulated assets (property, investments, savings) rather than income. It is a neutral, respectful term without the negative connotations that words like ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧ can sometimes carry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}{資産家|しさんか} (very wealthy person)
- {資産家|しさんか}⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧ (wealthy family/clan)
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{資産家|しさんか} (local person of means)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧ is the casual, everyday word for a rich person. ⟦{富裕層|ふゆうそう}→富裕層：12390_fuyuusou⟧ refers to the wealthy class as a group. {資産家|しさんか} is more formal than ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧ and emphasizes asset ownership specifically.
